```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Set up the report runtime environment and load the shared pipeline functions.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
# Locate the pipeline root from the Rmd file location or the working directory (compatible with both render and interactive runs; does not rely on .git/.Rproj).
input_dir <- tryCatch(
  dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), mustWork = FALSE)),
  error = function(e) ""
)
root_candidates <- unique(normalizePath(
  c(input_dir, getwd(), file.path(getwd(), "snRNAseq_publication_pipeline")),
  mustWork = FALSE
))
pipeline_root <- root_candidates[
  file.exists(file.path(root_candidates, "R", "pipeline_helpers.R"))
][1]
if (is.na(pipeline_root)) {
  stop("Cannot locate the pipeline root containing R/pipeline_helpers.R", call. = FALSE)
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = pipeline_root)
source(file.path(pipeline_root, "R", "pipeline_helpers.R"))
```

## Configuration

```{r libraries}
# Read enrichment analysis settings from the centralized parameter file.
source(file.path(pipeline_root, "config", "pipeline_params.R"))

# Check and load the packages required for GO/KEGG enrichment analysis and plotting.
check_packages(c(
  "dplyr", "ggplot2", "clusterProfiler", "org.Mm.eg.db",
  "enrichplot", "here"
))

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)

paths <- get_pipeline_paths(project_root = dirname(pipeline_root))
fig_dir <- ensure_dir(file.path(paths$fig_dir, "06_Pseudobulk_Enrichment"))
table_dir <- ensure_dir(file.path(paths$table_dir, "06_Pseudobulk_Enrichment"))

# DEG method selection, significance thresholds, and enrichment cutoffs are all defined in config/pipeline_params.R.
```

## Load pseudobulk DEG results


## Enrichment functions

```{r functions}
# Convert gene symbols to Entrez IDs for clusterProfiler enrichment analysis.
symbol_to_entrez <- function(genes) {
  genes <- unique(genes[!is.na(genes)])
  if (length(genes) == 0) return(character())
  ids <- suppressMessages(clusterProfiler::bitr(
    genes,
    fromType = "SYMBOL",
    toType = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db
  ))
  unique(ids$ENTREZID)
}

# Save the enrichment result table and dotplot; returns NULL when there are no significant terms.
save_enrichment <- function(enrich_obj, prefix, label) {
  if (is.null(enrich_obj) || nrow(as.data.frame(enrich_obj)) == 0) return(NULL)

  tab <- as.data.frame(enrich_obj)
  write.csv(tab, file.path(table_dir, paste0(prefix, "_", label, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)

  p <- enrichplot::dotplot(enrich_obj, showCategory = 15) +
    labs(title = paste(gsub("_", " ", prefix), label)) +
    theme_publication() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))
  save_pub_plot(p, paste0(prefix, "_", label, "_dotplot"), fig_dir, width = 8, height = 6)
  p
}

# Extract up- and down-regulated genes from a single DEG result and run GO BP and KEGG enrichment.
run_enrichment_for_result <- function(res, tissue, celltype, method) {
  if (is.null(res) || nrow(res) == 0) return(NULL)

  prefix <- paste(
    "06",
    sanitize_label(tissue),
    sanitize_label(celltype),
    sanitize_label(method),
    sep = "_"
  )

  universe_ids <- symbol_to_entrez(res$Gene)
  up_genes <- res |>
    filter(FDR < fdr_cutoff, logFC >= logfc_cutoff) |>
    pull(Gene)
  down_genes <- res |>
    filter(FDR < fdr_cutoff, logFC <= -logfc_cutoff) |>
    pull(Gene)

  run_direction <- function(genes, direction) {
    entrez <- symbol_to_entrez(genes)
    if (length(entrez) < min_genes_for_enrichment) {
      message("Skipping enrichment for ", tissue, " / ", celltype, " / ", direction, ": fewer than ", min_genes_for_enrichment, " mapped genes")
      return(NULL)
    }

# GO BP uses the mappable genes from the current DEG result as the universe.
    ego <- tryCatch(
      enrichGO(
        gene = entrez,
        universe = universe_ids,
        OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
        ont = "BP",
        pAdjustMethod = "BH",
        pvalueCutoff = go_pvalue_cutoff,
        qvalueCutoff = go_qvalue_cutoff,
        readable = TRUE
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

# KEGG uses the same significant gene set and converts IDs to readable gene names when results are available.
    ekegg <- tryCatch(
      enrichKEGG(
        gene = entrez,
        universe = universe_ids,
        organism = "mmu",
        pvalueCutoff = kegg_pvalue_cutoff,
        pAdjustMethod = "BH"
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (!is.null(ekegg) && nrow(as.data.frame(ekegg)) > 0) {
      ekegg <- setReadable(ekegg, OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")
    }

    p_go <- save_enrichment(ego, paste(prefix, direction, sep = "_"), "GO_BP")
    p_kegg <- save_enrichment(ekegg, paste(prefix, direction, sep = "_"), "KEGG")

    list(GO_BP = ego, KEGG = ekegg, Plot_GO = p_go, Plot_KEGG = p_kegg)
  }

  list(
    Up = run_direction(up_genes, "Up"),
    Down = run_direction(down_genes, "Down")
  )
}
```

## Run enrichment from pseudobulk DEG

```{r run_enrichment}
# Iterate over all tissues and cell types, running enrichment with the specified DEG method.
enrich_results <- list()

for (tissue in names(deg_results)) {
  enrich_results[[tissue]] <- list()
  for (celltype in names(deg_results[[tissue]])) {
    res <- deg_results[[tissue]][[celltype]][[deg_method_for_enrichment]]
    enrich_results[[tissue]][[celltype]] <- run_enrichment_for_result(
      res = res,
      tissue = tissue,
      celltype = celltype,
      method = deg_method_for_enrichment
    )
  }
}

# Save the full enrichment objects for later review or re-plotting.
saveRDS(enrich_results, file.path(paths$rds_dir, "06_pseudobulk_enrichment_results.rds"))
```

## Enrichment summary table

```{r summary}
# Summarize the number of GO/KEGG terms per tissue, cell type, and direction.
summarise_enrich <- function(enrich_results) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(enrich_results), function(tissue) {
    bind_rows(lapply(names(enrich_results[[tissue]]), function(celltype) {
      x <- enrich_results[[tissue]][[celltype]]
      if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
      bind_rows(lapply(c("Up", "Down"), function(direction) {
        y <- x[[direction]]
        if (is.null(y)) return(NULL)
        data.frame(
          Tissue = tissue,
          CellType = celltype,
          Direction = direction,
          GO_BP_Terms = ifelse(is.null(y$GO_BP), 0, nrow(as.data.frame(y$GO_BP))),
          KEGG_Terms = ifelse(is.null(y$KEGG), 0, nrow(as.data.frame(y$KEGG)))
        )
      }))
    }))
  }))
}

enrich_summary <- summarise_enrich(enrich_results)
# Save the enrichment analysis summary table.
write.csv(enrich_summary, file.path(table_dir, "06_pseudobulk_enrichment_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
enrich_summary
```
